gold.user: User A wants to check the cache usage for their organization to optimize their CI/CD workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current cache usage statistics for the specified organization.

gold.user: User B needs to retrieve a list of artifacts generated by workflows in their repository for review.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all artifacts available for the specified repository.

gold.user: User C is an admin and wants to review the GitHub Actions permissions set for their organization.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current permissions settings for GitHub Actions in the organization.

gold.user: User D wants to get detailed information about a specific workflow run to troubleshoot an issue.
gold.ideal: The API should return detailed information about the specified workflow run.

gold.user: User E needs to list all secrets configured for their organization to manage access securely.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all organization secrets.

gold.user: User F wants to retrieve the value of a specific repository variable for their CI/CD pipeline.
gold.ideal: The API should return the value of the specified repository variable.

gold.user: User G is looking to see all self-hosted runner groups in their organization to manage resources.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all self-hosted runner groups for the specified organization.

gold.user: User H wants to see all workflows configured in their repository to understand the CI/CD process.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all workflows for the specified repository.

gold.user: User I needs to check the permissions for self-hosted runners in their organization.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current permissions settings for self-hosted runners in the organization.

gold.user: User J wants to retrieve a specific secret from their repository to use in a workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should return the value of the specified repository secret.
